senses.gloss: m. (מני, with preform. הר, cmp. הרפתקי) appointment to office, authority, royal patent.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 1:12">Targ. Job I, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 2:7">II, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 17:11">Targ. Y. Num. XVII, 11</cite>.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:13">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> holding court <he>בלא ה׳ דמלכא</he> without royal appointment.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84a:2">B. Mets. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ דמלכא הוא</he> (Ms. R. 2 <he>הור׳</he>) it is a royal appointment (which I cannot decline).

<cite ref="Chullin 57b:12">Ḥull. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ דמלכא לא ליבעו</he> would they not have asked for royal authority? <cite ref="Chullin 57b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ דמלכא הוו נקיטי</he> they were in possession &c.; (Ar. ed. Koh. the king was among them <he>ומה׳ דמלכא עבוד</he> and they did it by royal authority).
B. Bath. 46ᵇ, v. next w.—Trnsf. (cmp. רָשׁוּת) office, bureau, esp. Resh Galutha’s office.

<cite ref="Eruvin 59a:9">Erub. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דשכיחי רבנן גבי ה׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300) because scholars are accustomed to meet at the Resh Galutha’s office (Ar. <cite ref="S00213"><he>קהרמנא</he></cite>).
